individuals.treatment_summary: Cephalosporins for about 1 week for presumed infectious diarrhea; oral iron dextran without improvement of anemia; after the genetic result (December 19, 2019) oral prednisone 12.5 mg/d plus iron supplement, prednisone reduced gradually to 10 mg/d; May 2020 (knee synovitis) oral prednisone 12.5 mg/dose twice daily plus subcutaneous rhTNFR:Fc 12.5 mg/week; October 2020 anti-inflammation therapy for a gastrointestinal episode; by January 25, 2021 iron stopped, prednisone 7.5 mg/d, rhTNFR:Fc unchanged
individuals.disease_label_as_stated: A20 haploinsufficiency (HA20); familial Behcet-like autoinflammatory syndrome; Table 1 diagnosis: BD, synovitis
individuals.clinical_diagnosis_basis: Whole-exome sequencing of peripheral blood (MyGenostics, Beijing, China) found a heterozygous TNFAIP3 frameshift variant; Sanger sequencing found no mutation in either parent; classified pathogenic per ACMG (PVS1, PS2, PM2)

variants.parental_testing_statement: The Sanger sequencing of their parents for pedigree verification is shown in Figure 4. The family verification analysis showed no mutation in the parents; thus, it was a spontaneous mutation (PS2). Figure 4: There was no mutation at the site of the father (B) and the mother (C).
variants.pathogenicity_as_stated_by_authors: preliminarily determined as pathogenic variation according to the ACMG guidelines
